tool_args.rationale: The short-window positive response and measured negative long-horizon response match the authorized dual-exponential adaptation law. Fit its four parameters numerically across all paid rows and use fresh confirmation to test it.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed response is consistent with the authorized simpler linear-in-input dual-horizon mechanism; all measured s_grad values are zero, so the sink parameter is not identified.
The slow-horizon probe supplies three additional time points spanning the reversal, sufficient to fit and confirm the four-parameter candidate.
The observed slow reversal and pilot signatures favor the authorized endogenous-adaptation mechanism.
